title: SRD 5.1 importer: class parser
description:
**DESIGN DECISIONS RECORDED — see ADR 0009** (docs/adr/0009-class-subclass-feature-record-kinds.md). HUMAN flag resolved 2026-05-29.

**Scope (narrowed):** This bead now covers **base-class parsing only** — the 12 SRD 5.1 base classes as `class` records. Subclasses and features are split out (see Decisions below).

**Prerequisites (apply to all SRD 5.1 importer child issues):**
- Vendored SRD 5.1 PDF at packages/core/sources/dnd5e-srd-5.1/SRD_CC_v5.1.pdf — see that directory's README.md.
- Reference implementation: mirror parseSpells.ts (parser), emit.ts (record builder + manifest description), index.ts (pipeline wiring), and the test layout under packages/core/test/importers/dnd5e-srd-5.1/.
- Depends on loreweaver-0m9.5.9 (section detection + orchestrator).

---

Add a class-section parser for SRD 5.1 base classes (kind=class). Extract each base class (hitDie, primaryAbilities, savingThrowProficiencies, armorProficiencies, weaponProficiencies) into RulesRecord shape satisfying validateDnd5eClass. The class record's `key` is the link target subclasses/features reference via data.parentClass / data.source.

**Design decisions (ADR 0009):**
1. **Subclasses** → their own new `subclass` kind (addressable by name via lookup_rules), linked to parent via data.parentClass. NOT `overrides` (that is pack-layering replacement in stack.ts). Kind infra: loreweaver-0m9.5.16; parser: loreweaver-0m9.5.17.
2. **Class features** → their own new `feature` kind (distinct from player-selected `feat`), linked to grantor via data.source + level. Kind infra: loreweaver-0m9.5.15; parser: loreweaver-0m9.5.18.
3. **Class spell lists** → already handled by parseSpells.ts parseSpellClassLists; no class-side duplication.

Rationale: the only DM query surface (lookup_rules in toolLookupRules.ts) is name+kind addressed, so subclasses/features must be top-level records to be retrievable by the names players say. Full analysis in ADR 0009.
acceptance_criteria:
- Parser extracts every SRD 5.1 BASE class (12) into kind=class records.
- Records satisfy the dnd5e-srd class kindSchema (validateDnd5eClass).
- Each class record's key is stable and usable as a parentClass/source link target for subclass + feature parsers.
- Manifest description includes 'class' in Included record kinds.
- Unit tests cover at least one class with simple progression (fighter) and one with complex features (cleric or wizard) — base-class fields only; feature/subclass extraction is out of scope here.
- Subclass and feature handling is deferred to 0m9.5.16/0m9.5.17 (subclass) and 0m9.5.15/0m9.5.18 (feature) per ADR 0009.
notes: Implemented: parseClasses.ts (Hit Dice signature detection + Armor/Weapons/Saving Throws labeled-line extraction, fail-closed on missing proficiency lines), classes section anchor, emit + index wiring, ClassExtraction type, CLI counts. 8 unit tests + pipeline integration (Fighter). primaryAbilities is best-effort [] per ADR 0007 (SRD Class Features block has no primary-ability line); Multiclassing-table cross-reference tracked in loreweaver-0m9.5.19. New kinds (subclass/feature) + ADR 0009 split to 0m9.5.15-18.
close_reason: Merged to main in PR #108 (commit 059f118): base-class parser with whitespace normalization, wrapped-list continuation, fail-closed class coverage guard, and ADR 0009. Subclass/feature kinds + primaryAbilities sourcing tracked in 0m9.5.15-19.
